summary: Form 6-K filed by Wisekey International Holding S.A. reporting that SEALSQ Corp (NASDAQ: LAES), a subsidiary, acquired a majority equity stake in Wecan Group after an initial 28% stake one year ago. SEALSQ will invest CHF 5 million to accelerate the development of an AI-powered Compliance Copilot on post-quantum infrastructure. The acquisition strengthens SEALSQ's quantum-compliant financial solutions. Terms such as exact ownership percentage and valuation were not disclosed. The transaction uses SEALSQ's internal Quantum Fund. What to watch: further integration with Wisekey's WISeID ecosystem and SEALSQ's ability to deploy quantum-resilient security for financial clients.
